name: Glasswing
summary: A seven-page glass project app: board, calendar, projects, time tracking with a live timer, team
about: A seven-page project management app with a clear frosted-glass look over soft colour blobs that glide to a new spot on every page. Teams move tasks on a board with a work-in-progress limit, plan on a draggable month calendar and track time with a running timer and an editable weekly timesheet. Good for a design studio, an agency, a startup or any small team that bills by the hour.
how: Home greets you with your hours, billable value and a liquid gauge of work done. Switch the hours chart between 7D and 30D to watch it morph.
On Board, drag tasks between columns or use the ⋯ menu. Doing shows its limit and warns when you go over. Press play on any card to time it.
On Calendar, drag a task or event to another day, click a date to add a task or event, and step through months.
On Time, pick a task and press Start. The timer runs in the top bar on every page. Stop it to log the entry, or type hours straight into the timesheet.
Projects shows budget used, billable value and hours per project. Team compares each person's week with their target.
Open any task for its drawer with fields, files and comments. Settings has the work limit, timer rounding, rates, theme and Reset demo data.
